obligations.summary: `db.name` | Removed, integrated into the new `db.namespace`. Clarified, it is RECOMMENDED to capture the value as provided by the application without attempting to do any case normalization
`db.instance.id` | Removed, replaced by `server.address` or integrated into `db.namespace` as appropriate
`db.statement` → `db.query.text` | Clarified, SHOULD be collected by default only if there is sanitization that excludes sensitive information
`db.operation` → `db.operation.name` | Clarified, it is RECOMMENDED to capture the value as provided by the application without attempting to do any case normalization

`db.sql.table` → `db.collection.name` | Should not be captured if extracting the value from `db.query.text` since there could be multiple. Clarified, it is RECOMMENDED to capture the value as provided by the application without attempting to do any case normalization
`db.cassandra.table` → `db.collection.name` | Clarified, it is RECOMMENDED to capture the value as provided by the application without attempting to do any case normalization
`db.mongodb.collection` → `db.collection.name` | Clarified, it is RECOMMENDED to capture the value as provided by the application without attempting to do any case normalization
`db.cosmosdb.container` → `db.collection.name` | Clarified, it is RECOMMENDED to capture the value as provided by the application without attempting to do any case normalization
The recommended span name has changed.
`rpc.system` → `rpc.system.name` | See [below](#rpcsystemname-values) for changes to the values, also now marked as sampling-relevant
`rpc.method` | Now contains fully-qualified method name (e.g., `com.example.ExampleService/exampleMethod`), also now marked as sampling-relevant

`server.address` | Now marked as sampling-relevant;
Now it’s taken from static configuration and can be any string identifying a group of server instances.

`server.port` | Now marked as sampling-relevant;
Now it’s taken from static configuration.
New: `rpc.method_original` | Original method name when `rpc.method` is set to `_OTHER`
| `java_rmi`                        | [#3176](https://github.com/open-telemetry/semantic-conventions/pull/3176) | Removed, but can still be used as a custom value |
| `dotnet_wcf`                      | [#3176](https://github.com/open-telemetry/semantic-conventions/pull/3176) | Removed, but can still be used as a custom value |
obsoleted db.cosmosdb.operation_type | Removed, no replacement at this time.
obsoleted db.instance.id | Removed, no general replacement at this time. For Elasticsearch, use `db.elasticsearch.node.name` instead.
obsoleted db.jdbc.driver_classname | Removed, no replacement at this time.
obsoleted db.mssql.instance_name | Removed, no replacement at this time.
uncategorized db.sql.table | Replaced by `db.collection.name`, but only if not extracting the value from `db.query.text`.
obsoleted db.user | Removed, no replacement at this time.
obsoleted message.compressed_size | Deprecated, no replacement at this time.
obsoleted message.id | Deprecated, no replacement at this time.
obsoleted message.type | Deprecated, no replacement at this time.
obsoleted message.uncompressed_size | Deprecated, no replacement at this time.
uncategorized rpc.grpc.status_code | Use string representation of the gRPC status code on the `rpc.response.status_code` attribute.
uncategorized rpc.jsonrpc.error_code | Use string representation of the error code on the `rpc.response.status_code` attribute.
uncategorized rpc.jsonrpc.error_message | Use the span status description when reporting JSON-RPC spans.
obsoleted rpc.message.compressed_size | Deprecated, no replacement at this time.
obsoleted rpc.message.id | Deprecated, no replacement at this time.
obsoleted rpc.message.type | Deprecated, no replacement at this time.
obsoleted rpc.message.uncompressed_size | Deprecated, no replacement at this time.
uncategorized rpc.service | Value should be included in `rpc.method` which is expected to be a fully-qualified name.
